title: When things go wrong
summary: Lost phone, card problems, asking for help

stages.title: Asking for help
stages.summary: Lost phone, card problems, asking for help

sentences.pt: O meu cartão não está a funcionar.

sentences.en: I need a police report for the insurance.
sentences.es: Necesito una denuncia para el seguro.
sentences.pt: Preciso de uma participação para o seguro.

sentences.es: Hace una hora, más o menos.
sentences.pt: Há mais ou menos uma hora.

sentences.en: My passport was in my bag.
sentences.es: Tenía el pasaporte en el bolso.

sentences.en: Where is the nearest police station?
sentences.pt: Onde fica a esquadra mais próxima?
Onde fica a embaixada da Alemanha?

sentences.en: I need an emergency travel document.
sentences.es: Necesito un documento de viaje de emergencia.
sentences.pt: Preciso de um documento de viagem de emergência.

sentences.en: My flight is the day after tomorrow.
sentences.pt: O meu voo é depois de amanhã.

sentences.en: Here is a copy of my passport.
sentences.es: Aquí tiene una copia del pasaporte.
sentences.pt: Aqui está uma cópia do passaporte.

sentences.en: There's smoke coming out of the building.
sentences.pt: Está a sair fumo do prédio.

passages.text: Para bloquear la tarjeta tiene que llamar a su banco, el número está en la aplicación. Y para el móvil, lo mejor es poner una denuncia en la comisaría; la más cercana está en esta misma calle, al fondo.
passages.en: To block the card you have to call your bank, the number is in the app. And for the phone, it's best to report it at the police station; the nearest one is at the end of this same street.
passages.question: What two things should you do?
passages.answer: Call your bank to block the card, and report the phone at the police station down this street.
wrong: Visit a bank branch, then buy a new phone.
Call the police about the card, and wait for the phone.
Go back to your hotel and wait for a call.

passages.text: Para cancelar o cartão tem de ligar para o seu banco, o número está na aplicação. Quanto ao telemóvel, o melhor é fazer queixa na esquadra; a mais próxima fica nesta mesma rua, lá ao fundo.
passages.en: To cancel the card you have to call your bank, the number is in the app. As for the phone, it's best to report it at the police station; the nearest one is at the far end of this same street.
passages.question: What two things should you do?
passages.answer: Call your bank to cancel the card, and report the phone at the police station down this street.
wrong: Visit a bank branch, then buy a new phone.
Call the police about the card, and wait for the phone.
Go back to your hotel and wait for a call.

passages.text: Para la denuncia necesito su pasaporte o una copia, y una lista de lo que había en la cartera. Le doy una copia sellada para el seguro. Si aparece algo, le llamamos a este número.
passages.en: For the report I need your passport or a copy, and a list of what was in the wallet. I'll give you a stamped copy for the insurance. If anything turns up, we'll call this number.
passages.question: What do you get for the insurance?
passages.answer: A stamped copy of the report.

passages.text: Para a participação preciso do seu passaporte ou de uma cópia, e de uma lista do que estava na carteira. Dou-lhe uma cópia carimbada para o seguro. Se aparecer alguma coisa, ligamos para este número.
passages.en: For the report I need your passport or a copy, and a list of what was in the wallet. I'll give you a stamped copy for the insurance. If anything turns up, we'll call this number.
passages.question: What do you get for the insurance?
passages.answer: A stamped copy of the report.

passages.text: Si ha perdido el pasaporte, le hacemos un documento provisional en el día, pero necesita la denuncia de la policía, dos fotos y el billete de avión. La oficina abre de nueve a una.
passages.en: If you've lost your passport, we issue a temporary document the same day, but you need the police report, two photos and your plane ticket. The office is open from nine to one.
passages.question: What do you need to bring?
passages.answer: The police report, two photos and the plane ticket.
wrong: Three photos and a bank card.

passages.text: Se perdeu o passaporte, fazemos-lhe um documento provisório no próprio dia, mas precisa da participação da polícia, duas fotografias e o bilhete de avião. A secção consular abre das nove à uma.
passages.en: If you've lost your passport, we issue a temporary document the same day, but you need the police report, two photos and your plane ticket. The office is open from nine to one.
passages.question: What do you need to bring?
passages.answer: The police report, two photos and the plane ticket.
wrong: Three photos and a bank card.

passages.text: Ha llamado a emergencias. Dígame qué ha pasado y dónde está exactamente. No mueva a la persona; compruebe si respira. Una ambulancia va de camino; llegará en unos ocho minutos.
passages.en: You've called emergency services. Tell me what happened and exactly where you are. Don't move the person; check whether they're breathing. An ambulance is on its way and will arrive in about eight minutes.
passages.question: What should you do with the injured person?
passages.answer: Don't move them; check they're breathing.

passages.text: Ligou para o número de emergência. Diga-me o que aconteceu e onde está exatamente. Não mexa na pessoa; veja se está a respirar. Vai uma ambulância a caminho; chega daqui a uns oito minutos.
passages.en: You've called emergency services. Tell me what happened and exactly where you are. Don't move the person; check whether they're breathing. An ambulance is on its way and will arrive in about eight minutes.
passages.question: What should you do with the injured person?
passages.answer: Don't move them; check they're breathing.
